about: Footprints whose City height (approx_hgt/max_hgt) is a data error, checked against the 2024 aerial. Applied in scripts/05_build_scene.py (pixelphilly.reviewed). mode "neighbor": the median height of other footprints within 25 m; "meters": a fixed height in "meters". Overridden footprints are not LiDAR-shaped.

entries.reason: Recorded 138 ft (approx_hgt) on a 38 m² footprint. The 2024 aerial shows a small round object, possibly a tank, in a scrapyard with almost no shadow, so it can't be 42 m tall. The record is a data error. It tripped the needle gate in east_riverfront.
